cat > tests/test_discounts.py <<'"'EOF'
from datetime import date

import pytest

from shoplib.discounts import Coupon, apply_coupon, apply_coupons


def test_percent():
    assert apply_coupon(1000, Coupon(\"TEN\", \"percent\", 10)) == 900


def test_fixed_never_negative():
    assert apply_coupon(300, Coupon(\"FIVE\", \"fixed\", 500)) == 0


def test_apply_coupons_selects_highest_percent_and_sorts_codes():
    coupons = [
        Coupon(\"Z-TEN\", \"percent\", 10),
        Coupon(\"B-TWENTY\", \"percent\", 20),
        Coupon(\"A-TWENTY\", \"percent\", 20),
        Coupon(\"C-FIXED\", \"fixed\", 125),
        Coupon(\"A-FIXED\", \"fixed\", 75),
    ]

    assert apply_coupons(2000, coupons, date(2025, 1, 1)) == (
        1425,
        [\"A-FIXED\", \"A-TWENTY\", \"C-FIXED\"],
    )


def test_apply_coupons_checks_expiry_and_minimum_against_original_subtotal():
    today = date(2025, 1, 1)
    coupons = [
        Coupon(\"EXPIRED\", \"fixed\", 1000, expires=date(2024, 12, 31)),
        Coupon(\"VALID-ON-DATE\", \"fixed\", 100, expires=today),
        Coupon(\"MINIMUM\", \"fixed\", 500, min_subtotal_cents=1000),
        Coupon(\"TOO-HIGH-MINIMUM\", \"fixed\", 1000, min_subtotal_cents=1001),
    ]

    assert apply_coupons(1000, coupons, today) == (400, [\"MINIMUM\", \"VALID-ON-DATE\"])


def test_apply_coupons_applies_percent_before_fixed_and_clamps_at_zero():
    coupons = [
        Coupon(\"HALF\", \"percent\", 50),
        Coupon(\"FIXED\", \"fixed\", 600),
    ]

    assert apply_coupons(1000, coupons, date(2025, 1, 1)) == (0, [\"FIXED\", \"HALF\"])


def test_apply_coupons_with_no_eligible_coupons_returns_original_total():
    coupons = [
        Coupon(\"EXPIRED\", \"fixed\", 100, expires=date(2024, 12, 31)),
        Coupon(\"MINIMUM\", \"fixed\", 100, min_subtotal_cents=1001),
    ]

    assert apply_coupons(1000, coupons, date(2025, 1, 1)) == (1000, [])


def test_apply_coupons_rejects_negative_subtotal():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"subtotal must not be negative\"):
        apply_coupons(-1, [], date(2025, 1, 1))
EOF
